# QnALog 1.7.1

A bug-fix release for first-time organization, reorganizing notes, and the settings page.

## Fixed

- **An interrupted first organize is recovered.** The first organization of a recording is now saved as a queue task before the model is called. If Obsidian is closed or reloaded, or the plugin stops while the model is running, the task is picked up again after restart instead of leaving the note unorganized.
- **Reorganize titles.** Reorganizing a note in place now replaces the `(recording...)` placeholder in the title. A note that was never organized is treated as a first organize. A note that still has the bare timestamp as its file name is renamed to the new title.
- **Settings quick setup.** The quick setup card is re-evaluated each time the settings page is drawn, so it no longer stays visible after the configuration is complete, and it has a close button. Reopening Quick config with missing configuration no longer asks for a reconfigure confirmation.
- **Settings page scroll and panels.** Redrawing the settings page keeps the scroll position and the open or closed state of the provider panels.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. No settings are dropped or changed.
- No need to reconfigure services or API keys.
- Existing notes, recordings and folders are not moved, rewritten or deleted by the upgrade.
